svg.text: 4 bedrooms / 3 full bathrooms • Revised interior layout • Front entrance below
R = retained original room label. P = proposed clear size.
Room areas exclude walls; dressing area includes its fitted storage once.
Bedroom 4 closet is separate from its 107.1 sq ft sleeping room.
Bedroom 3 closet split: 11.6 + 2.1 divider + 15.3 = 29.0 sq ft.
No whole-house or addition total is claimed without verified exterior sizes.
Opening height is the clear modeled opening; door leaves are smaller.
Reference revision: proposed 12 sq ft canted bay; main room rectangles retain the previous layout.
Use the companion detail sheet for closet divisions, shared-toilet position, open dressing passage and primary-bath fixtures.
Dimensions are derived from the model, rounded to ⅛ inch. Confirm field conditions and retained structure before construction.
